135/**
136 * A Swing GUI component for displaying a {@link JFreeChart} object.
137 * <P>
138 * The panel registers with the chart to receive notification of changes to any
139 * component of the chart.  The chart is redrawn automatically whenever this
140 * notification is received.
141 */
142public class ChartPanel extends JPanel implements ChartChangeListener,
143        ChartProgressListener, ActionListener, MouseListener,
144        MouseMotionListener, OverlayChangeListener, Printable, Serializable {

483        this(chart, DEFAULT_WIDTH, DEFAULT_HEIGHT,

485            DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_DRAW_WIDTH, DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_DRAW_HEIGHT,

489            true,  // print
490            true,  // zoom
491            true   // tooltips

493
494    }

496    /**
497     * Constructs a panel containing a chart.  The {@code useBuffer} flag
498     * controls whether an offscreen {@code BufferedImage} is
499     * maintained for the chart.  If the buffer is used, more memory is
500     * consumed, but panel repaints will be a lot quicker in cases where the
501     * chart itself hasn't changed (for example, when another frame is moved
502     * to reveal the panel).  WARNING: If you set the {@code useBuffer}
503     * flag to false, note that the mouse zooming rectangle will (in that case)
504     * be drawn using XOR, and there is a SEVERE performance problem with that
505     * on JRE6 on Windows.
506     *
507     * @param chart  the chart.
508     * @param useBuffer  a flag controlling whether an off-screen buffer
509     *                   is used (read the warning above before setting this
510     *                   to {@code false}).
511     */
512    public ChartPanel(JFreeChart chart, boolean useBuffer) {
513
514        this(chart, DEFAULT_WIDTH, DEFAULT_HEIGHT, DEFAULT_MINIMUM_DRAW_WIDTH,
515                DEFAULT_MINIMUM_DRAW_HEIGHT, DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_DRAW_WIDTH,
516                DEFAULT_MAXIMUM_DRAW_HEIGHT, useBuffer,
517                true,  // properties
518                true,  // save
519                true,  // print
520                true,  // zoom
521                true   // tooltips
522                );
523
524    }
525

551    /**
552     * Constructs a JFreeChart panel.
553     *
554     * @param chart  the chart.
555     * @param width  the preferred width of the panel.
556     * @param height  the preferred height of the panel.
557     * @param minimumDrawWidth  the minimum drawing width.
558     * @param minimumDrawHeight  the minimum drawing height.
559     * @param maximumDrawWidth  the maximum drawing width.
560     * @param maximumDrawHeight  the maximum drawing height.
561     * @param useBuffer  a flag that indicates whether to use the off-screen
562     *                   buffer to improve performance (at the expense of
563     *                   memory).
564     * @param properties  a flag indicating whether the chart property
565     *                    editor should be available via the popup menu.
566     * @param save  a flag indicating whether save options should be
567     *              available via the popup menu.
568     * @param print  a flag indicating whether the print option
569     *               should be available via the popup menu.
570     * @param zoom  a flag indicating whether zoom options should be
571     *              added to the popup menu.
572     * @param tooltips  a flag indicating whether tooltips should be
573     *                  enabled for the chart.
574     */
575    public ChartPanel(JFreeChart chart, int width, int height,
576            int minimumDrawWidth, int minimumDrawHeight, int maximumDrawWidth,
577            int maximumDrawHeight, boolean useBuffer, boolean properties,
578            boolean save, boolean print, boolean zoom, boolean tooltips) {
579
580        this(chart, width, height, minimumDrawWidth, minimumDrawHeight,
581                maximumDrawWidth, maximumDrawHeight, useBuffer, properties,
582                true, save, print, zoom, tooltips);
583    }
584
585    /**
586     * Constructs a JFreeChart panel.
587     *
588     * @param chart  the chart.
589     * @param width  the preferred width of the panel.
590     * @param height  the preferred height of the panel.
591     * @param minimumDrawWidth  the minimum drawing width.
592     * @param minimumDrawHeight  the minimum drawing height.
593     * @param maximumDrawWidth  the maximum drawing width.
594     * @param maximumDrawHeight  the maximum drawing height.
595     * @param useBuffer  a flag that indicates whether to use the off-screen
596     *                   buffer to improve performance (at the expense of
597     *                   memory).
598     * @param properties  a flag indicating whether the chart property
599     *                    editor should be available via the popup menu.
600     * @param copy  a flag indicating whether a copy option should be
601     *              available via the popup menu.
602     * @param save  a flag indicating whether save options should be
603     *              available via the popup menu.
604     * @param print  a flag indicating whether the print option
605     *               should be available via the popup menu.
606     * @param zoom  a flag indicating whether zoom options should be
607     *              added to the popup menu.
608     * @param tooltips  a flag indicating whether tooltips should be
609     *                  enabled for the chart.
610     */
611    public ChartPanel(JFreeChart chart, int width, int height,
612           int minimumDrawWidth, int minimumDrawHeight, int maximumDrawWidth,
613           int maximumDrawHeight, boolean useBuffer, boolean properties,
614           boolean copy, boolean save, boolean print, boolean zoom,
615           boolean tooltips) {
616
617        setChart(chart);
618        this.chartMouseListeners = new EventListenerList();
619        this.info = new ChartRenderingInfo();
620        setPreferredSize(new Dimension(width, height));
621        this.useBuffer = useBuffer;
622        this.refreshBuffer = false;
623        this.minimumDrawWidth = minimumDrawWidth;
624        this.minimumDrawHeight = minimumDrawHeight;
625        this.maximumDrawWidth = maximumDrawWidth;
626        this.maximumDrawHeight = maximumDrawHeight;
627        this.zoomTriggerDistance = DEFAULT_ZOOM_TRIGGER_DISTANCE;
628
629        // set up popup menu...
630        this.popup = null;
631        if (properties || copy || save || print || zoom) {
632            this.popup = createPopupMenu(properties, copy, save, print, zoom);
633        }
634
635        enableEvents(AWTEvent.MOUSE_EVENT_MASK);
636        enableEvents(AWTEvent.MOUSE_MOTION_EVENT_MASK);
637        setDisplayToolTips(tooltips);
638        addMouseListener(this);
639        addMouseMotionListener(this);
640
641        this.defaultDirectoryForSaveAs = null;
642        this.enforceFileExtensions = true;
643
644        // initialize ChartPanel-specific tool tip delays with
645        // values the from ToolTipManager.sharedInstance()
646        ToolTipManager ttm = ToolTipManager.sharedInstance();
647        this.ownToolTipInitialDelay = ttm.getInitialDelay();
648        this.ownToolTipDismissDelay = ttm.getDismissDelay();
649        this.ownToolTipReshowDelay = ttm.getReshowDelay();
650
651        this.zoomAroundAnchor = false;
652        this.zoomOutlinePaint = Color.BLUE;
653        this.zoomFillPaint = new Color(0, 0, 255, 63);
654
655        this.moveChartEntityFillPaint = new Color(0, 0, 0, 63);
656
657        // for MacOSX we can't use the CTRL key for mouse drags, see:
658        // http://developer.apple.com/qa/qa2004/qa1362.html
659        String osName = System.getProperty("os.name").toLowerCase();
660        if (osName.startsWith("mac os x")) {
661            this.panPredicate = InputEvent::isAltDown;
662        }
663
664        this.overlays = new ArrayList<>();
665    }

676    /**
677     * Sets the chart that is displayed in the panel.
678     *
679     * @param chart  the chart ({@code null} permitted).
680     */
681    public void setChart(JFreeChart chart) {
682
683        final JFreeChart oldChart = this.chart;
684        // stop listening for changes to the existing chart
685        if (oldChart != null) {
686            oldChart.removeChangeListener(this);
687            oldChart.removeProgressListener(this);
688        }
689
690        // add the new chart
691        this.chart = chart;
692        if (chart != null) {
693            this.chart.addChangeListener(this);
694            this.chart.addProgressListener(this);
695            Plot plot = chart.getPlot();
696            this.domainZoomable = false;
697            this.rangeZoomable = false;
698            if (plot instanceof Zoomable) {
699                Zoomable z = (Zoomable) plot;
700                this.domainZoomable = z.isDomainZoomable();
701                this.rangeZoomable = z.isRangeZoomable();
702                this.orientation = z.getOrientation();
703            }
704        }
705        else {
706            this.domainZoomable = false;
707            this.rangeZoomable = false;
708        }
709        if (this.useBuffer) {
710            this.refreshBuffer = true;
711        }
712        firePropertyChange(PROPERTY_CHART, oldChart, chart);
713        repaint();
714
715    }

1312     * generate tooltip items.

1314     * @param flag  {@code true} to enable tooltips, {@code false} to
1315     *              disable tooltips.
1316     */

1318        if (flag) {

1320        }

1323        }

1326    /**
1327     * Returns a string for the tooltip.
1328     *
1329     * @param e  the mouse event.
1330     *
1331     * @return A tool tip or {@code null} if no tooltip is available.
1332     */
1333    @Override
1334    public String getToolTipText(MouseEvent e) {
1335        String result = null;
1336        if (this.info != null) {
1337            EntityCollection entities = this.info.getEntityCollection();
1338            if (entities != null) {
1339                Insets insets = getInsets();
1340                ChartEntity entity = entities.getEntity(
1341                        (int) ((e.getX() - insets.left) / this.scaleX),
1342                        (int) ((e.getY() - insets.top) / this.scaleY));
1343                if (entity != null) {
1344                    result = entity.getToolTipText();
1345                }
1346            }
1347        }
1348        return result;
1349    }

1351    /**
1352     * Translates a Java2D point on the chart to a screen location.
1353     *
1354     * @param java2DPoint  the Java2D point.
1355     *
1356     * @return The screen location.
1357     */
1358    public Point translateJava2DToScreen(Point2D java2DPoint) {
1359        Insets insets = getInsets();
1360        int x = (int) (java2DPoint.getX() * this.scaleX + insets.left);
1361        int y = (int) (java2DPoint.getY() * this.scaleY + insets.top);
1362        return new Point(x, y);
1363    }
1364
1365    /**
1366     * Translates a panel (component) location to a Java2D point.
1367     *
1368     * @param screenPoint  the screen location ({@code null} not
1369     *                     permitted).
1370     *
1371     * @return The Java2D coordinates.
1372     */
1373    public Point2D translateScreenToJava2D(Point screenPoint) {
1374        Insets insets = getInsets();
1375        double x = (screenPoint.getX() - insets.left) / this.scaleX;
1376        double y = (screenPoint.getY() - insets.top) / this.scaleY;
1377        return new Point2D.Double(x, y);
1378    }
1379
1380    /**
1381     * Applies any scaling that is in effect for the chart drawing to the
1382     * given rectangle.
1383     *
1384     * @param rect  the rectangle ({@code null} not permitted).
1385     *
1386     * @return A new scaled rectangle.
1387     */
1388    public Rectangle2D scale(Rectangle2D rect) {
1389        Insets insets = getInsets();
1390        double x = rect.getX() * getScaleX() + insets.left;
1391        double y = rect.getY() * getScaleY() + insets.top;
1392        double w = rect.getWidth() * getScaleX();
1393        double h = rect.getHeight() * getScaleY();
1394        return new Rectangle2D.Double(x, y, w, h);
1395    }

1397    /**
1398     * Returns the chart entity at a given point.
1399     * <P>
1400     * This method will return null if there is (a) no entity at the given
1401     * point, or (b) no entity collection has been generated.
1402     *
1403     * @param viewX  the x-coordinate.
1404     * @param viewY  the y-coordinate.
1405     *
1406     * @return The chart entity (possibly {@code null}).
1407     */
1408    public ChartEntity getEntityForPoint(int viewX, int viewY) {
1409
1410        ChartEntity result = null;
1411        if (this.info != null) {
1412            Insets insets = getInsets();
1413            double x = (viewX - insets.left) / this.scaleX;
1414            double y = (viewY - insets.top) / this.scaleY;
1415            EntityCollection entities = this.info.getEntityCollection();
1416            result = entities != null ? entities.getEntity(x, y) : null;
1417        }
1418        return result;
1419
1420    }

1443    /**
1444     * Paints the component by drawing the chart to fill the entire component,
1445     * but allowing for the insets (which will be non-zero if a border has been
1446     * set for this component).  To increase performance (at the expense of
1447     * memory), an off-screen buffer image can be used.
1448     *
1449     * @param g  the graphics device for drawing on.
1450     */
1451    @Override
1452    public void paintComponent(Graphics g) {
1453        super.paintComponent(g);
1454        if (this.chart == null) {
1455            return;
1456        }
1457        Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) g.create();
1458        
1459        // first determine the size of the chart rendering area...
1460        Dimension size = getSize();
1461        Insets insets = getInsets();
1462        final int availableWidth = size.width - insets.left - insets.right; 
1463        final int availableHeight = size.height - insets.top - insets.bottom;
1464
1465        // work out if scaling is required...
1466        boolean scale = false;
1467        int drawWidth = availableWidth;
1468        int drawHeight = availableHeight;
1469        this.scaleX = 1.0;
1470        this.scaleY = 1.0;
1471
1472        if (drawWidth < this.minimumDrawWidth) {
1473            this.scaleX = (double) drawWidth / (double) this.minimumDrawWidth;
1474            drawWidth = this.minimumDrawWidth;
1475            scale = true;
1476        }
1477        else if (drawWidth > this.maximumDrawWidth) {
1478            this.scaleX = (double) drawWidth / (double) this.maximumDrawWidth;
1479            drawWidth = this.maximumDrawWidth;
1480            scale = true;
1481        }
1482
1483        if (drawHeight < this.minimumDrawHeight) {
1484            this.scaleY = (double) drawHeight / (double) this.minimumDrawHeight;
1485            drawHeight = this.minimumDrawHeight;
1486            scale = true;
1487        }
1488        else if (drawHeight > this.maximumDrawHeight) {
1489            this.scaleY = (double) drawHeight / (double) this.maximumDrawHeight;
1490            drawHeight = this.maximumDrawHeight;
1491            scale = true;
1492        }
1493
1494        Dimension chartSize = new Dimension(drawWidth, drawHeight);
1495
1496        // are we using the chart buffer?
1497        if (this.useBuffer) {
1498
1499            // for better rendering on the HiDPI monitors upscaling the buffer to the "native" resolution
1500            // instead of using logical one provided by Swing
1501            final AffineTransform globalTransform = ((Graphics2D) g).getTransform();
1502            final double globalScaleX = globalTransform.getScaleX();
1503            final double globalScaleY = globalTransform.getScaleY();
1504
1505            final Dimension bufferSize = new Dimension(
1506                    (int) Math.ceil(availableWidth * globalScaleX),
1507                    (int) Math.ceil(availableHeight * globalScaleY));
1508
1509            this.chartBuffer = paintChartToBuffer(g2, bufferSize, chartSize, anchor, info);
1510
1511            // zap the buffer onto the panel...
1512            g2.drawImage(this.chartBuffer, insets.left, insets.top, availableWidth, availableHeight, this);
1513            g2.addRenderingHints(this.chart.getRenderingHints()); // bug#187
1514
1515        } else { // redrawing the chart every time...
1516            AffineTransform saved = g2.getTransform();
1517            g2.translate(insets.left, insets.top);
1518            if (scale) {
1519                AffineTransform st = AffineTransform.getScaleInstance(
1520                        this.scaleX, this.scaleY);
1521                g2.transform(st);
1522            }
1523            this.chart.draw(g2, new Rectangle(chartSize), this.anchor, this.info);
1524            g2.setTransform(saved);
1525
1526        }
1527
1528        for (Overlay overlay : this.overlays) {
1529            overlay.paintOverlay(g2, this);
1530        }
1531
1532        // redraw the zoom rectangle (if present) - if useBuffer is false,
1533        // we use XOR so we can XOR the rectangle away again without redrawing
1534        // the chart
1535        drawZoomRectangle(g2, !this.useBuffer);
1536        drawMovableChartEntity(g2, !this.useBuffer);
1537
1538        g2.dispose();
1539
1540        this.anchor = null;
1541        this.verticalTraceLine = null;
1542        this.horizontalTraceLine = null;
1543    }
1544
1545    /**
1546     * Paints the chart to fill the entire off-screen buffer image.
1547     * 
1548     * @param g2         the graphics context to create an off-screen buffer
1549     *                   image.
1550     * @param bufferSize the required off-screen buffer image size.
1551     * @param chartSize  the size with which the chart should be drawn (apply
1552     *                   scaling if not equal to {@code bufferSize}).
1553     * @param anchor     the anchor point (in Java2D space) for the chart
1554     *                   ({@code null} permitted).
1555     * @param info       records info about the drawing ({@code null} means
1556     *                   collect no info).
1557     * @return the off-screen buffer image to draw onto the panel.
1558     */
1559    protected BufferedImage paintChartToBuffer(Graphics2D g2, Dimension bufferSize,
1560            Dimension chartSize, Point2D anchor, ChartRenderingInfo info) {
1561        final BufferedImage buffer;
1562        if ((this.chartBuffer == null)
1563                || (this.chartBuffer.getWidth() != bufferSize.width)
1564                || (this.chartBuffer.getHeight() != bufferSize.height)) {
1565            GraphicsConfiguration gc = g2.getDeviceConfiguration();
1566
1567            buffer = gc.createCompatibleImage(bufferSize.width,
1568                    bufferSize.height, Transparency.TRANSLUCENT);
1569
1570            this.refreshBuffer = true;
1571        } else {
1572            buffer = this.chartBuffer;
1573        }
1574        
1575        
1576        // do we need to redraw the buffer?
1577        if (this.refreshBuffer) {
1578
1579            this.refreshBuffer = false; // clear the flag
1580
1581            Graphics2D bufferG2 = buffer.createGraphics();
1582            if (!bufferSize.equals(chartSize)) {
1583                // Scale the chart to fit the buffer
1584                bufferG2.scale(
1585                        bufferSize.getWidth() / chartSize.getWidth(),
1586                        bufferSize.getHeight() / chartSize.getHeight());
1587            }
1588            Rectangle chartArea = new Rectangle(chartSize);
1589
1590            // make the background of the buffer clear and transparent
1591            Composite savedComposite = bufferG2.getComposite();
1592            bufferG2.setComposite(AlphaComposite.getInstance(AlphaComposite.CLEAR, 0.0f));
1593            bufferG2.fill(chartArea);
1594            bufferG2.setComposite(savedComposite);
1595            
1596            this.chart.draw(bufferG2, chartArea, this.anchor, this.info);
1597            bufferG2.dispose();
1598        }
1599        
1600        return buffer;
1601    }

1603    /**
1604     * Receives notification of changes to the chart, and redraws the chart.
1605     *
1606     * @param event  details of the chart change event.
1607     */
1608    @Override
1609    public void chartChanged(ChartChangeEvent event) {
1610        this.refreshBuffer = true;
1611        Plot plot = this.chart.getPlot();
1612        if (plot instanceof Zoomable) {
1613            Zoomable z = (Zoomable) plot;
1614            this.orientation = z.getOrientation();
1615        }
1616        repaint();
1617    }

1629    /**
1630     * Handles action events generated by the popup menu.
1631     *
1632     * @param event  the event.
1633     */
1634    @Override
1635    public void actionPerformed(ActionEvent event) {
1636
1637        String command = event.getActionCommand();
1638
1639        // many of the zoom methods need a screen location - all we have is
1640        // the zoomPoint, but it might be null.  Here we grab the x and y
1641        // coordinates, or use defaults...
1642        double screenX = -1.0;
1643        double screenY = -1.0;
1644        if (this.zoomPoint != null) {
1645            screenX = this.zoomPoint.getX();
1646            screenY = this.zoomPoint.getY();
1647        }
1648
1649        switch (command) {
1650            case PROPERTIES_COMMAND:
1651                doEditChartProperties();
1652                break;
1653            case COPY_COMMAND:
1654                doCopy();
1655                break;
1656            case SAVE_AS_PNG_COMMAND:
1657                try {
1658                    doSaveAs();
1659                } catch (IOException e) {
1660                    JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this, "I/O error occurred.",
1661                            localizationResources.getString("Save_as_PNG"),
1662                            JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
1663                }
1664                break;
1665            case SAVE_AS_SVG_COMMAND:
1666                try {
1667                    saveAsSVG(null);
1668                } catch (IOException e) {
1669                    JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(this, "I/O error occurred.",
1670                            localizationResources.getString("Save_as_SVG"),
1671                            JOptionPane.WARNING_MESSAGE);
1672                }
1673                break;
1674            case SAVE_AS_PDF_COMMAND:
1675                saveAsPDF(null);
1676                break;
1677            case PRINT_COMMAND:
1678                createChartPrintJob();
1679                break;
1680            case ZOOM_IN_BOTH_COMMAND:
1681                zoomInBoth(screenX, screenY);
1682                break;
1683            case ZOOM_IN_DOMAIN_COMMAND:
1684                zoomInDomain(screenX, screenY);
1685                break;
1686            case ZOOM_IN_RANGE_COMMAND:
1687                zoomInRange(screenX, screenY);
1688                break;
1689            case ZOOM_OUT_BOTH_COMMAND:
1690                zoomOutBoth(screenX, screenY);
1691                break;
1692            case ZOOM_OUT_DOMAIN_COMMAND:
1693                zoomOutDomain(screenX, screenY);
1694                break;
1695            case ZOOM_OUT_RANGE_COMMAND:
1696                zoomOutRange(screenX, screenY);
1697                break;
1698            case ZOOM_RESET_BOTH_COMMAND:
1699                restoreAutoBounds();
1700                break;
1701            case ZOOM_RESET_DOMAIN_COMMAND:
1702                restoreAutoDomainBounds();
1703                break;
1704            case ZOOM_RESET_RANGE_COMMAND:
1705                restoreAutoRangeBounds();
1706                break;
1707        }
1708    }

1710    /**
1711     * Handles a 'mouse entered' event. This method changes the tooltip delays
1712     * of ToolTipManager.sharedInstance() to the possibly different values set
1713     * for this chart panel.
1714     *
1715     * @param e  the mouse event.
1716     */
1717    @Override
1718    public void mouseEntered(MouseEvent e) {
1719        if (!this.ownToolTipDelaysActive) {
1720            ToolTipManager ttm = ToolTipManager.sharedInstance();
1721
1722            this.originalToolTipInitialDelay = ttm.getInitialDelay();
1723            ttm.setInitialDelay(this.ownToolTipInitialDelay);
1724
1725            this.originalToolTipReshowDelay = ttm.getReshowDelay();
1726            ttm.setReshowDelay(this.ownToolTipReshowDelay);
1727
1728            this.originalToolTipDismissDelay = ttm.getDismissDelay();
1729            ttm.setDismissDelay(this.ownToolTipDismissDelay);
1730
1731            this.ownToolTipDelaysActive = true;
1732        }
1733    }
1734
1735    /**
1736     * Handles a 'mouse exited' event. This method resets the tooltip delays of
1737     * ToolTipManager.sharedInstance() to their
1738     * original values in effect before mouseEntered()
1739     *
1740     * @param e  the mouse event.
1741     */
1742    @Override
1743    public void mouseExited(MouseEvent e) {
1744        if (this.ownToolTipDelaysActive) {
1745            // restore original tooltip dealys
1746            ToolTipManager ttm = ToolTipManager.sharedInstance();
1747            ttm.setInitialDelay(this.originalToolTipInitialDelay);
1748            ttm.setReshowDelay(this.originalToolTipReshowDelay);
1749            ttm.setDismissDelay(this.originalToolTipDismissDelay);
1750            this.ownToolTipDelaysActive = false;
1751        }
1752    }
1753
1754    /**
1755     * Handles a 'mouse pressed' event.
1756     * <P>
1757     * This event is the popup trigger on Unix/Linux.  For Windows, the popup
1758     * trigger is the 'mouse released' event.
1759     *
1760     * @param e  The mouse event.
1761     */
1762    @Override
1763    public void mousePressed(MouseEvent e) {
1764        if (this.chart == null) {
1765            return;
1766        }
1767        Plot plot = this.chart.getPlot();
1768        if (this.panPredicate.test(e)) {
1769            // can we pan this plot?
1770            if (plot instanceof Pannable) {
1771                Pannable pannable = (Pannable) plot;
1772                if (pannable.isDomainPannable() || pannable.isRangePannable()) {
1773                    Rectangle2D screenDataArea = getScreenDataArea(e.getX(),
1774                            e.getY());
1775                    if (screenDataArea != null && screenDataArea.contains(
1776                            e.getPoint())) {
1777                        this.panW = screenDataArea.getWidth();
1778                        this.panH = screenDataArea.getHeight();
1779                        this.panLast = e.getPoint();
1780                        setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(
1781                                Cursor.MOVE_CURSOR));
1782                        e.consume();
1783                    }
1784                }
1785                // the actual panning occurs later in the mouseDragged() 
1786                // method
1787            }
1788            return;
1789        }
1790        
1791        if (moveChartEntityPredicate.test(e)) {
1792            Insets insets = getInsets();
1793            int x = (int) ((e.getX() - insets.left) / this.scaleX);
1794            int y = (int) ((e.getY() - insets.top) / this.scaleY);
1795
1796            ChartEntity entity = null;
1797            if (this.info != null) {
1798                EntityCollection entities = this.info.getEntityCollection();
1799                if (entities != null) {
1800                    entity = entities.getEntity(x, y);
1801                }
1802            }
1803            if (entity instanceof MovableChartEntity) {
1804                this.movableChartEntity = (MovableChartEntity) entity;
1805                this.moveChartEntityFrom = new Point(x, y);
1806                setCursor(Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(Cursor.MOVE_CURSOR));
1807                e.consume();
1808                return;
1809            }
1810        }
1811        
1812        if (this.zoomRectangle == null) {
1813            Rectangle2D screenDataArea = getScreenDataArea(e.getX(), e.getY());
1814            if (screenDataArea != null) {
1815                this.zoomPoint = getPointInRectangle(e.getX(), e.getY(),
1816                        screenDataArea);
1817            }
1818            else {
1819                this.zoomPoint = null;
1820            }
1821            if (this.popup != null && this.popupPredicate.test(e)) {
1822                displayPopupMenu(e.getX(), e.getY());
1823                e.consume();
1824            }
1825        }
1826    }
1827
1828    /**
1829     * Returns a point based on (x, y) but constrained to be within the bounds
1830     * of the given rectangle.  This method could be moved to JCommon.
1831     *
1832     * @param x  the x-coordinate.
1833     * @param y  the y-coordinate.
1834     * @param area  the rectangle ({@code null} not permitted).
1835     *
1836     * @return A point within the rectangle.
1837     */
1838    private Point2D getPointInRectangle(int x, int y, Rectangle2D area) {
1839        double xx = Math.max(area.getMinX(), Math.min(x, area.getMaxX()));
1840        double yy = Math.max(area.getMinY(), Math.min(y, area.getMaxY()));
1841        return new Point2D.Double(xx, yy);
1842    }
1843
1844    /**
1845     * Handles a 'mouse dragged' event.
1846     *
1847     * @param e  the mouse event.
1848     */
1849    @Override
1850    public void mouseDragged(MouseEvent e) {
1851
1852        // if the popup menu has already been triggered, then ignore dragging...
1853        if (this.popup != null && this.popup.isShowing()) {
1854            e.consume();
1855            return;
1856        }
1857
1858        // handle panning if we have a start point
1859        if (this.panLast != null) {
1860            double dx = e.getX() - this.panLast.getX();
1861            double dy = e.getY() - this.panLast.getY();
1862            if (dx == 0.0 && dy == 0.0) {
1863                return;
1864            }
1865            double wPercent = -dx / this.panW;
1866            double hPercent = dy / this.panH;
1867            boolean old = this.chart.getPlot().isNotify();
1868            this.chart.getPlot().setNotify(false);
1869            Pannable p = (Pannable) this.chart.getPlot();
1870            if (p.getOrientation() == PlotOrientation.VERTICAL) {
1871                p.panDomainAxes(wPercent, this.info.getPlotInfo(),
1872                        this.panLast);
1873                p.panRangeAxes(hPercent, this.info.getPlotInfo(),
1874                        this.panLast);
1875            }
1876            else {
1877                p.panDomainAxes(hPercent, this.info.getPlotInfo(),
1878                        this.panLast);
1879                p.panRangeAxes(wPercent, this.info.getPlotInfo(),
1880                        this.panLast);
1881            }
1882            this.panLast = e.getPoint();
1883            this.chart.getPlot().setNotify(old);
1884            e.consume();
1885            return;
1886        }
1887
1888        if (this.movableChartEntity != null) {
1889            Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) getGraphics();
1890            // Erase the previous movable chart entity (if any). We only need to
1891            // do this is we are using XOR mode, which we do when we're not
1892            // using the buffer (if there is a buffer, then at the end of this
1893            // method we just trigger a repaint)
1894            if (!this.useBuffer) {
1895                drawMovableChartEntity(g2, true);
1896            }
1897
1898            Insets insets = getInsets();
1899            int x = (int) ((e.getX() - insets.left) / this.scaleX);
1900            int y = (int) ((e.getY() - insets.top) / this.scaleY);
1901            this.moveChartEntityTo = this.movableChartEntity
1902                    .tryMove(this.moveChartEntityFrom, new Point(x, y));
1903
1904            setCursor(null == moveChartEntityTo ? INVALID_MOVE_CURSOR
1905                    : Cursor.getPredefinedCursor(Cursor.MOVE_CURSOR));
1906
1907            // Draw the new movable chart entity...
1908            if (this.useBuffer) {
1909                repaint();
1910            } else {
1911                // with no buffer, we use XOR to draw the rectangle "over" the
1912                // chart...
1913                drawMovableChartEntity(g2, true);
1914            }
1915            g2.dispose();
1916            e.consume();
1917            return;
1918        }
1919
1920        // if no initial zoom point was set, ignore dragging...
1921        if (this.zoomPoint == null) {
1922            return;
1923        }
1924        Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) getGraphics();
1925
1926        // erase the previous zoom rectangle (if any).  We only need to do
1927        // this is we are using XOR mode, which we do when we're not using
1928        // the buffer (if there is a buffer, then at the end of this method we
1929        // just trigger a repaint)
1930        if (!this.useBuffer) {
1931            drawZoomRectangle(g2, true);
1932        }
1933
1934        boolean hZoom, vZoom;
1935        if (this.orientation == PlotOrientation.HORIZONTAL) {
1936            hZoom = this.rangeZoomable;
1937            vZoom = this.domainZoomable;
1938        }
1939        else {
1940            hZoom = this.domainZoomable;
1941            vZoom = this.rangeZoomable;
1942        }
1943        if (this.zoomDomainPredicate.test(e)) {
1944            if (this.orientation == PlotOrientation.HORIZONTAL) {
1945                hZoom = false;
1946            } else {
1947                vZoom = false;
1948            }
1949        } else if (this.zoomRangePredicate.test(e)) {
1950            if (this.orientation == PlotOrientation.HORIZONTAL) {
1951                vZoom = false;
1952            } else {
1953                hZoom = false;
1954            }
1955        }
1956        Rectangle2D scaledDataArea = getScreenDataArea(
1957                (int) this.zoomPoint.getX(), (int) this.zoomPoint.getY());
1958        if (hZoom && vZoom) {
1959            // selected rectangle shouldn't extend outside the data area...
1960            double xmax = Math.min(e.getX(), scaledDataArea.getMaxX());
1961            double ymax = Math.min(e.getY(), scaledDataArea.getMaxY());
1962            this.zoomRectangle = new Rectangle2D.Double(
1963                    this.zoomPoint.getX(), this.zoomPoint.getY(),
1964                    xmax - this.zoomPoint.getX(), ymax - this.zoomPoint.getY());
1965        }
1966        else if (hZoom) {
1967            double xmax = Math.min(e.getX(), scaledDataArea.getMaxX());
1968            this.zoomRectangle = new Rectangle2D.Double(
1969                    this.zoomPoint.getX(), scaledDataArea.getMinY(),
1970                    xmax - this.zoomPoint.getX(), scaledDataArea.getHeight());
1971        }
1972        else if (vZoom) {
1973            double ymax = Math.min(e.getY(), scaledDataArea.getMaxY());
1974            this.zoomRectangle = new Rectangle2D.Double(
1975                    scaledDataArea.getMinX(), this.zoomPoint.getY(),
1976                    scaledDataArea.getWidth(), ymax - this.zoomPoint.getY());
1977        }
1978
1979        // Draw the new zoom rectangle...
1980        if (this.useBuffer) {
1981            repaint();
1982        }
1983        else {
1984            // with no buffer, we use XOR to draw the rectangle "over" the
1985            // chart...
1986            drawZoomRectangle(g2, true);
1987        }
1988        g2.dispose();
1989        e.consume();
1990
1991    }
1992
1993    /**
1994     * Handles a 'mouse released' event.  On Windows, we need to check if this
1995     * is a popup trigger, but only if we haven't already been tracking a zoom
1996     * rectangle.
1997     *
1998     * @param e  information about the event.
1999     */
2000    @Override
2001    public void mouseReleased(MouseEvent e) {
2002
2003        // if we've been panning, we need to reset now that the mouse is 
2004        // released...
2005        if (this.panLast != null) {
2006            this.panLast = null;
2007            setCursor(Cursor.getDefaultCursor());
2008            e.consume();
2009        }
2010
2011        else if (this.movableChartEntity != null) {
2012            Insets insets = getInsets();
2013            int x = (int) ((e.getX() - insets.left) / this.scaleX);
2014            int y = (int) ((e.getY() - insets.top) / this.scaleY);
2015            this.moveChartEntityTo = this.movableChartEntity
2016                    .tryMove(this.moveChartEntityFrom, new Point(x, y));
2017
2018            if (null != this.moveChartEntityTo && !Objects
2019                    .equals(this.moveChartEntityFrom, this.moveChartEntityTo)) {
2020                this.movableChartEntity.move(this.moveChartEntityFrom,
2021                        this.moveChartEntityTo);
2022            }
2023
2024            this.movableChartEntity = null;
2025            this.moveChartEntityFrom = null;
2026            this.moveChartEntityTo = null;
2027            setCursor(Cursor.getDefaultCursor());
2028        }
2029
2030        else if (this.zoomRectangle != null) {
2031            boolean hZoom, vZoom;
2032            if (this.orientation == PlotOrientation.HORIZONTAL) {
2033                hZoom = this.rangeZoomable;
2034                vZoom = this.domainZoomable;
2035            }
2036            else {
2037                hZoom = this.domainZoomable;
2038                vZoom = this.rangeZoomable;
2039            }
2040            if (this.zoomDomainPredicate.test(e)) {
2041                if (this.orientation == PlotOrientation.HORIZONTAL) {
2042                    hZoom = false;
2043                } else {
2044                    vZoom = false;
2045                }
2046            } else if (this.zoomRangePredicate.test(e)) {
2047                if (this.orientation == PlotOrientation.HORIZONTAL) {
2048                    vZoom = false;
2049                } else {
2050                    hZoom = false;
2051                }
2052            }
2053
2054            boolean zoomTrigger1 = hZoom && Math.abs(e.getX()
2055                - this.zoomPoint.getX()) >= this.zoomTriggerDistance;
2056            boolean zoomTrigger2 = vZoom && Math.abs(e.getY()
2057                - this.zoomPoint.getY()) >= this.zoomTriggerDistance;
2058            if (zoomTrigger1 || zoomTrigger2) {
2059                if ((hZoom && (e.getX() < this.zoomPoint.getX()))
2060                    || (vZoom && (e.getY() < this.zoomPoint.getY()))) {
2061                    if (this.zoomDomainPredicate.test(e)) {
2062                        restoreAutoDomainBounds();
2063                    } else if (this.zoomRangePredicate.test(e)) {
2064                        restoreAutoRangeBounds();
2065                    } else {
2066                        restoreAutoBounds();
2067                    }
2068                }
2069                else {
2070                    double x, y, w, h;
2071                    Rectangle2D screenDataArea = getScreenDataArea(
2072                            (int) this.zoomPoint.getX(),
2073                            (int) this.zoomPoint.getY());
2074                    double maxX = screenDataArea.getMaxX();
2075                    double maxY = screenDataArea.getMaxY();
2076                    // for mouseReleased event, (horizontalZoom || verticalZoom)
2077                    // will be true, so we can just test for either being false;
2078                    // otherwise both are true
2079                    if (!vZoom) {
2080                        x = this.zoomPoint.getX();
2081                        y = screenDataArea.getMinY();
2082                        w = Math.min(this.zoomRectangle.getWidth(),
2083                                maxX - this.zoomPoint.getX());
2084                        h = screenDataArea.getHeight();
2085                    }
2086                    else if (!hZoom) {
2087                        x = screenDataArea.getMinX();
2088                        y = this.zoomPoint.getY();
2089                        w = screenDataArea.getWidth();
2090                        h = Math.min(this.zoomRectangle.getHeight(),
2091                                maxY - this.zoomPoint.getY());
2092                    }
2093                    else {
2094                        x = this.zoomPoint.getX();
2095                        y = this.zoomPoint.getY();
2096                        w = Math.min(this.zoomRectangle.getWidth(),
2097                                maxX - this.zoomPoint.getX());
2098                        h = Math.min(this.zoomRectangle.getHeight(),
2099                                maxY - this.zoomPoint.getY());
2100                    }
2101                    Rectangle2D zoomArea = new Rectangle2D.Double(x, y, w, h);
2102                    zoom(zoomArea);
2103                }
2104                this.zoomPoint = null;
2105                this.zoomRectangle = null;
2106            }
2107            else {
2108                // erase the zoom rectangle
2109                Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) getGraphics();
2110                if (this.useBuffer) {
2111                    repaint();
2112                }
2113                else {
2114                    drawZoomRectangle(g2, true);
2115                }
2116                g2.dispose();
2117                this.zoomPoint = null;
2118                this.zoomRectangle = null;
2119            }
2120            e.consume();
2121
2122        }
2123
2124        else if (this.popup != null && this.popupPredicate.test(e)) {
2125            displayPopupMenu(e.getX(), e.getY());
2126            e.consume();
2127        }
2128
2129    }

2131    /**
2132     * Receives notification of mouse clicks on the panel. These are
2133     * translated and passed on to any registered {@link ChartMouseListener}s.
2134     *
2135     * @param event  Information about the mouse event.
2136     */
2137    @Override
2138    public void mouseClicked(MouseEvent event) {
2139
2140        Insets insets = getInsets();
2141        int x = (int) ((event.getX() - insets.left) / this.scaleX);
2142        int y = (int) ((event.getY() - insets.top) / this.scaleY);
2143
2144        this.anchor = new Point2D.Double(x, y);
2145        if (this.chart == null) {
2146            return;
2147        }
2148        this.chart.handleClick(x, y, this.info);
2149
2150        // new entity code...
2151        Object[] listeners = this.chartMouseListeners.getListeners(
2152                ChartMouseListener.class);
2153        if (listeners.length == 0) {
2154            return;
2155        }
2156
2157        ChartEntity entity = null;
2158        if (this.info != null) {
2159            EntityCollection entities = this.info.getEntityCollection();
2160            if (entities != null) {
2161                entity = entities.getEntity(x, y);
2162            }
2163        }
2164        ChartMouseEvent chartEvent = new ChartMouseEvent(getChart(), event,
2165                entity);
2166        for (int i = listeners.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
2167            ((ChartMouseListener) listeners[i]).chartMouseClicked(chartEvent);
2168        }
2169
2170    }
2171
2172    /**
2173     * Implementation of the MouseMotionListener's method.
2174     *
2175     * @param e  the event.
2176     */
2177    @Override
2178    public void mouseMoved(MouseEvent e) {
2179        Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) getGraphics();
2180        if (this.horizontalAxisTrace) {
2181            drawHorizontalAxisTrace(g2, e.getX());
2182        }
2183        if (this.verticalAxisTrace) {
2184            drawVerticalAxisTrace(g2, e.getY());
2185        }
2186        g2.dispose();
2187
2188        Object[] listeners = this.chartMouseListeners.getListeners(
2189                ChartMouseListener.class);
2190        if (listeners.length == 0) {
2191            return;
2192        }
2193        Insets insets = getInsets();
2194        int x = (int) ((e.getX() - insets.left) / this.scaleX);
2195        int y = (int) ((e.getY() - insets.top) / this.scaleY);
2196
2197        ChartEntity entity = null;
2198        if (this.info != null) {
2199            EntityCollection entities = this.info.getEntityCollection();
2200            if (entities != null) {
2201                entity = entities.getEntity(x, y);
2202            }
2203        }
2204
2205        // we can only generate events if the panel's chart is not null
2206        // (see bug report 1556951)
2207        if (this.chart != null) {
2208            ChartMouseEvent event = new ChartMouseEvent(getChart(), e, entity);
2209            for (int i = listeners.length - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
2210                ((ChartMouseListener) listeners[i]).chartMouseMoved(event);
2211            }
2212        }
2213
2214    }

2354    /**
2355     * Zooms in on a selected region.
2356     *
2357     * @param selection  the selected region.
2358     */
2359    public void zoom(Rectangle2D selection) {
2360
2361        // get the origin of the zoom selection in the Java2D space used for
2362        // drawing the chart (that is, before any scaling to fit the panel)
2363        Point2D selectOrigin = translateScreenToJava2D(new Point(
2364                (int) Math.ceil(selection.getX()),
2365                (int) Math.ceil(selection.getY())));
2366        PlotRenderingInfo plotInfo = this.info.getPlotInfo();
2367        Rectangle2D scaledDataArea = getScreenDataArea(
2368                (int) selection.getCenterX(), (int) selection.getCenterY());
2369        if ((selection.getHeight() > 0) && (selection.getWidth() > 0)) {
2370
2371            double hLower = (selection.getMinX() - scaledDataArea.getMinX())
2372                / scaledDataArea.getWidth();
2373            double hUpper = (selection.getMaxX() - scaledDataArea.getMinX())
2374                / scaledDataArea.getWidth();
2375            double vLower = (scaledDataArea.getMaxY() - selection.getMaxY())
2376                / scaledDataArea.getHeight();
2377            double vUpper = (scaledDataArea.getMaxY() - selection.getMinY())
2378                / scaledDataArea.getHeight();
2379
2380            Plot p = this.chart.getPlot();
2381            if (p instanceof Zoomable) {
2382                // here we tweak the notify flag on the plot so that only
2383                // one notification happens even though we update multiple
2384                // axes...
2385                boolean savedNotify = p.isNotify();
2386                p.setNotify(false);
2387                Zoomable z = (Zoomable) p;
2388                if (z.getOrientation() == PlotOrientation.HORIZONTAL) {
2389                    z.zoomDomainAxes(vLower, vUpper, plotInfo, selectOrigin);
2390                    z.zoomRangeAxes(hLower, hUpper, plotInfo, selectOrigin);
2391                }
2392                else {
2393                    z.zoomDomainAxes(hLower, hUpper, plotInfo, selectOrigin);
2394                    z.zoomRangeAxes(vLower, vUpper, plotInfo, selectOrigin);
2395                }
2396                p.setNotify(savedNotify);
2397            }
2398
2399        }
2400
2401    }

2520    /**
2521     * Returns the data area for the chart (the area inside the axes) with the
2522     * current scaling applied (that is, the area as it appears on screen).
2523     *
2524     * @return The scaled data area.
2525     */
2526    public Rectangle2D getScreenDataArea() {
2527        Rectangle2D dataArea = this.info.getPlotInfo().getDataArea();
2528        Insets insets = getInsets();
2529        double x = dataArea.getX() * this.scaleX + insets.left;
2530        double y = dataArea.getY() * this.scaleY + insets.top;
2531        double w = dataArea.getWidth() * this.scaleX;
2532        double h = dataArea.getHeight() * this.scaleY;
2533        return new Rectangle2D.Double(x, y, w, h);
2534    }
2535
2536    /**
2537     * Returns the data area (the area inside the axes) for the plot or subplot,
2538     * with the current scaling applied.
2539     *
2540     * @param x  the x-coordinate (for subplot selection).
2541     * @param y  the y-coordinate (for subplot selection).
2542     *
2543     * @return The scaled data area.
2544     */
2545    public Rectangle2D getScreenDataArea(int x, int y) {
2546        PlotRenderingInfo plotInfo = this.info.getPlotInfo();
2547        Rectangle2D result;
2548        if (plotInfo.getSubplotCount() == 0) {
2549            result = getScreenDataArea();
2550        }
2551        else {
2552            // get the origin of the zoom selection in the Java2D space used for
2553            // drawing the chart (that is, before any scaling to fit the panel)
2554            Point2D selectOrigin = translateScreenToJava2D(new Point(x, y));
2555            int subplotIndex = plotInfo.getSubplotIndex(selectOrigin);
2556            if (subplotIndex == -1) {
2557                return null;
2558            }
2559            result = scale(plotInfo.getSubplotInfo(subplotIndex).getDataArea());
2560        }
2561        return result;
2562    }

2678    /**
2679     * Draws a rectangle (if present) to show where the movable chart entity
2680     * will move to.
2681     * 
2682     * @param g2  the graphics device.
2683     * @param xor use XOR for drawing?
2684     */
2685    private void drawMovableChartEntity(Graphics2D g2, boolean xor) {
2686        if (this.movableChartEntity != null && this.moveChartEntityFrom != null
2687                && this.moveChartEntityTo != null) {
2688            Graphics2D g = (Graphics2D) g2.create();
2689            if (xor) {
2690                // Set XOR mode to draw the zoom rectangle
2691                g.setXORMode(Color.GRAY);
2692            }
2693            Insets insets = getInsets();
2694            double scaledMoveX = (this.moveChartEntityTo.getX()
2695                    - this.moveChartEntityFrom.getX()) * this.scaleX;
2696            double scaledMoveY = (this.moveChartEntityTo.getY()
2697                    - this.moveChartEntityFrom.getY()) * this.scaleY;
2698
2699            g.setPaint(this.moveChartEntityFillPaint);
2700            g.translate(insets.left + scaledMoveX, insets.top + scaledMoveY);
2701            g.scale(this.scaleX, this.scaleY);
2702            g.fill(this.movableChartEntity.getArea());
2703            g.dispose();
2704        }
2705    }

2727    /**
2728     * Draws zoom rectangle (if present). The drawing is performed in XOR mode,
2729     * therefore when this method is called twice in a row, the second call will
2730     * completely restore the state of the canvas.
2731     *
2732     * @param g2  the graphics device.
2733     * @param xor use XOR for drawing?
2734     */
2735    private void drawZoomRectangle(Graphics2D g2, boolean xor) {
2736        if (this.zoomRectangle != null) {
2737            if (xor) {
2738                 // Set XOR mode to draw the zoom rectangle
2739                g2.setXORMode(Color.GRAY);
2740            }
2741            if (this.fillZoomRectangle) {
2742                g2.setPaint(this.zoomFillPaint);
2743                g2.fill(this.zoomRectangle);
2744            }
2745            else {
2746                g2.setPaint(this.zoomOutlinePaint);
2747                g2.draw(this.zoomRectangle);
2748            }
2749            if (xor) {
2750                // Reset to the default 'overwrite' mode
2751                g2.setPaintMode();
2752            }
2753        }
2754    }
2755
2756    /**
2757     * Draws a vertical line used to trace the mouse position to the horizontal
2758     * axis.
2759     *
2760     * @param g2 the graphics device.
2761     * @param x  the x-coordinate of the trace line.
2762     */
2763    private void drawHorizontalAxisTrace(Graphics2D g2, int x) {
2764
2765        Rectangle2D dataArea = getScreenDataArea();
2766
2767        g2.setXORMode(Color.ORANGE);
2768        if (((int) dataArea.getMinX() < x) && (x < (int) dataArea.getMaxX())) {
2769
2770            if (this.verticalTraceLine != null) {
2771                g2.draw(this.verticalTraceLine);
2772                this.verticalTraceLine.setLine(x, (int) dataArea.getMinY(), x,
2773                        (int) dataArea.getMaxY());
2774            }
2775            else {
2776                this.verticalTraceLine = new Line2D.Float(x,
2777                        (int) dataArea.getMinY(), x, (int) dataArea.getMaxY());
2778            }
2779            g2.draw(this.verticalTraceLine);
2780        }
2781
2782        // Reset to the default 'overwrite' mode
2783        g2.setPaintMode();
2784    }

2788     * axis.

2793    private void drawVerticalAxisTrace(Graphics2D g2, int y) {

2795        Rectangle2D dataArea = getScreenDataArea();

2799
2800            if (this.horizontalTraceLine != null) {

2909    /**
2910     * Saves the chart in SVG format (a filechooser will be displayed so that
2911     * the user can specify the filename).  Note that this method only works
2912     * if the JFreeSVG library is on the classpath...if this library is not 
2913     * present, the method will fail.
2914     */
2915    private void saveAsSVG(File f) throws IOException {
2916        File file = f;
2917        if (file == null) {
2918            JFileChooser fileChooser = new JFileChooser();
2919            fileChooser.setCurrentDirectory(this.defaultDirectoryForSaveAs);
2920            FileNameExtensionFilter filter = new FileNameExtensionFilter(
2921                    localizationResources.getString("SVG_Files"), "svg");
2922            fileChooser.addChoosableFileFilter(filter);
2923            fileChooser.setFileFilter(filter);
2924
2925            int option = fileChooser.showSaveDialog(this);
2926            if (option == JFileChooser.APPROVE_OPTION) {
2927                String filename = fileChooser.getSelectedFile().getPath();
2928                if (isEnforceFileExtensions()) {
2929                    if (!filename.endsWith(".svg")) {
2930                        filename = filename + ".svg";
2931                    }
2932                }
2933                file = new File(filename);
2934                if (file.exists()) {
2935                    String fileExists = localizationResources.getString(
2936                            "FILE_EXISTS_CONFIRM_OVERWRITE");
2937                    int response = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(this, 
2938                            fileExists,
2939                            localizationResources.getString("Save_as_SVG"),
2940                            JOptionPane.OK_CANCEL_OPTION);
2941                    if (response == JOptionPane.CANCEL_OPTION) {
2942                        file = null;
2943                    }
2944                }
2945            }
2946        }
2947        
2948        if (file != null) {
2949            // use reflection to get the SVG string
2950            String svg = generateSVG(getWidth(), getHeight());
2951            try (BufferedWriter writer = new BufferedWriter(new FileWriter(file))) {
2952                writer.write("<!DOCTYPE svg PUBLIC \"-//W3C//DTD SVG 1.1//EN\" \"http://www.w3.org/Graphics/SVG/1.1/DTD/svg11.dtd\">\n");
2953                writer.write(svg + "\n");
2954                writer.flush();
2955            } catch (IOException ex) {
2956                throw new RuntimeException(ex);
2957            }
2958
2959        }
2960    }
2961    
2962    /**
2963     * Generates a string containing a rendering of the chart in SVG format.
2964     * This feature is only supported if the JFreeSVG library is included on 
2965     * the classpath.
2966     * 
2967     * @return A string containing an SVG element for the current chart, or 
2968     *     {@code null} if there is a problem with the method invocation
2969     *     by reflection.
2970     */
2971    private String generateSVG(int width, int height) {
2972        Graphics2D g2 = createSVGGraphics2D(width, height);
2973        if (g2 == null) {
2974            throw new IllegalStateException("JFreeSVG library is not present.");
2975        }
2976        // we suppress shadow generation, because SVG is a vector format and
2977        // the shadow effect is applied via bitmap effects...
2978        g2.setRenderingHint(JFreeChart.KEY_SUPPRESS_SHADOW_GENERATION, true);
2979        String svg = null;
2980        Rectangle2D drawArea = new Rectangle2D.Double(0, 0, width, height);
2981        this.chart.draw(g2, drawArea);
2982        try {
2983            Method m = g2.getClass().getMethod("getSVGElement");
2984            svg = (String) m.invoke(g2);
2985        } catch (NoSuchMethodException | SecurityException | IllegalAccessException | IllegalArgumentException |
2986                 InvocationTargetException e) {
2987            // null will be returned
2988        }
2989        return svg;
2990    }
2991
2992    private Graphics2D createSVGGraphics2D(int w, int h) {
2993        try {
2994            Class<?> svgGraphics2d = Class.forName("org.jfree.graphics2d.svg.SVGGraphics2D");
2995            Constructor<?> ctor = svgGraphics2d.getConstructor(int.class, int.class);
2996            return (Graphics2D) ctor.newInstance(w, h);
2997        } catch (ClassNotFoundException | NoSuchMethodException | SecurityException | InstantiationException |
2998                 IllegalAccessException | IllegalArgumentException | InvocationTargetException ex) {
2999            return null;
3000        }
3001    }

3047    /**
3048     * Returns {@code true} if OrsonPDF is on the classpath, and 
3049     * {@code false} otherwise.  The OrsonPDF library can be found at
3050     * <a href="https://github.com/jfree/orsonpdf">GitHub</a>
3051     *
3052     * @return A boolean.
3053     */
3054    private boolean isOrsonPDFAvailable() {
3055        Class<?> pdfDocumentClass = null;
3056        try {
3057            pdfDocumentClass = Class.forName("com.orsonpdf.PDFDocument");
3058        } catch (ClassNotFoundException e) {
3059            // pdfDocument class will be null so the function will return false
3060        }
3061        return (pdfDocumentClass != null);
3062    }

3064    /**
3065     * Writes the current chart to the specified file in PDF format.  This 
3066     * will only work when the OrsonPDF library is found on the classpath.
3067     * Reflection is used to ensure there is no compile-time dependency on
3068     * OrsonPDF (which is non-free software).
3069     * 
3070     * @param file  the output file ({@code null} not permitted).
3071     * @param w  the chart width.
3072     * @param h  the chart height.
3073     */
3074    private void writeAsPDF(File file, int w, int h) {
3075        if (!isOrsonPDFAvailable()) {
3076            throw new IllegalStateException(
3077                    "OrsonPDF is not present on the classpath.");
3078        }
3079        Args.nullNotPermitted(file, "file");
3080        try {
3081            Class<?> pdfDocClass = Class.forName("com.orsonpdf.PDFDocument");
3082            Object pdfDoc = pdfDocClass.getDeclaredConstructor().newInstance();
3083            Method m = pdfDocClass.getMethod("createPage", Rectangle2D.class);
3084            Rectangle2D rect = new Rectangle(w, h);
3085            Object page = m.invoke(pdfDoc, rect);
3086            Method m2 = page.getClass().getMethod("getGraphics2D");
3087            Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) m2.invoke(page);
3088            // we suppress shadow generation, because PDF is a vector format and
3089            // the shadow effect is applied via bitmap effects...
3090            g2.setRenderingHint(JFreeChart.KEY_SUPPRESS_SHADOW_GENERATION, true);
3091            Rectangle2D drawArea = new Rectangle2D.Double(0, 0, w, h);
3092            this.chart.draw(g2, drawArea);
3093            Method m3 = pdfDocClass.getMethod("writeToFile", File.class);
3094            m3.invoke(pdfDoc, file);
3095        } catch (ClassNotFoundException | InstantiationException | IllegalAccessException | NoSuchMethodException |
3096                 SecurityException | IllegalArgumentException | InvocationTargetException ex) {
3097            throw new RuntimeException(ex);
3098        }
3099    }

3121    /**
3122     * Prints the chart on a single page.
3123     *
3124     * @param g  the graphics context.
3125     * @param pf  the page format to use.
3126     * @param pageIndex  the index of the page. If not {@code 0}, nothing
3127     *                   gets printed.
3128     *
3129     * @return The result of printing.
3130     */
3131    @Override
3132    public int print(Graphics g, PageFormat pf, int pageIndex) {
3133
3134        if (pageIndex != 0) {
3135            return NO_SUCH_PAGE;
3136        }
3137        Graphics2D g2 = (Graphics2D) g;
3138        double x = pf.getImageableX();
3139        double y = pf.getImageableY();
3140        double w = pf.getImageableWidth();
3141        double h = pf.getImageableHeight();
3142        this.chart.draw(g2, new Rectangle2D.Double(x, y, w, h), this.anchor,
3143                null);
3144        return PAGE_EXISTS;
3145
3146    }

3358                    localizationResources.getString("Range_Axis"));
3359            this.zoomResetRangeMenuItem.setActionCommand(
3360                    ZOOM_RESET_RANGE_COMMAND);
3361            this.zoomResetRangeMenuItem.addActionListener(this);
3362            autoRangeMenu.add(this.zoomResetRangeMenuItem);
3363
3364            result.addSeparator();
3365            result.add(autoRangeMenu);
3366
3367        }
3368
3369        return result;
3370
3371    }
3372
3373    /**
3374     * The idea is to modify the zooming options depending on the type of chart
3375     * being displayed by the panel.
3376     *
3377     * @param x  horizontal position of the popup.
3378     * @param y  vertical position of the popup.
3379     */
3380    protected void displayPopupMenu(int x, int y) {
3381
3382        if (this.popup == null) {
3383            return;
3384        }
3385
3386        // go through each zoom menu item and decide whether to
3387        // enable it...
3388        boolean isDomainZoomable = false;
3389        boolean isRangeZoomable = false;
3390        Plot plot = (this.chart != null ? this.chart.getPlot() : null);
3391        if (plot instanceof Zoomable) {
3392            Zoomable z = (Zoomable) plot;
3393            isDomainZoomable = z.isDomainZoomable();
3394            isRangeZoomable = z.isRangeZoomable();
3395        }
3396
3397        if (this.zoomInDomainMenuItem != null) {
3398            this.zoomInDomainMenuItem.setEnabled(isDomainZoomable);
3399        }
3400        if (this.zoomOutDomainMenuItem != null) {
3401            this.zoomOutDomainMenuItem.setEnabled(isDomainZoomable);
3402        }
3403        if (this.zoomResetDomainMenuItem != null) {
3404            this.zoomResetDomainMenuItem.setEnabled(isDomainZoomable);
3405        }
3406
3407        if (this.zoomInRangeMenuItem != null) {
3408            this.zoomInRangeMenuItem.setEnabled(isRangeZoomable);
3409        }
3410        if (this.zoomOutRangeMenuItem != null) {
3411            this.zoomOutRangeMenuItem.setEnabled(isRangeZoomable);
3412        }
3413
3414        if (this.zoomResetRangeMenuItem != null) {
3415            this.zoomResetRangeMenuItem.setEnabled(isRangeZoomable);
3416        }
3417
3418        if (this.zoomInBothMenuItem != null) {
3419            this.zoomInBothMenuItem.setEnabled(isDomainZoomable
3420                    && isRangeZoomable);
3421        }
3422        if (this.zoomOutBothMenuItem != null) {
3423            this.zoomOutBothMenuItem.setEnabled(isDomainZoomable
3424                    && isRangeZoomable);
3425        }
3426        if (this.zoomResetBothMenuItem != null) {
3427            this.zoomResetBothMenuItem.setEnabled(isDomainZoomable
3428                    && isRangeZoomable);
3429        }
3430
3431        this.popup.show(this, x, y);
3432
3433    }

3448    /**
3449     * Provides serialization support.
3450     *
3451     * @param stream  the output stream.
3452     *
3453     * @throws IOException  if there is an I/O error.
3454     */
3455    private void writeObject(ObjectOutputStream stream) throws IOException {
3456        stream.defaultWriteObject();
3457        SerialUtils.writePaint(this.zoomFillPaint, stream);
3458        SerialUtils.writePaint(this.zoomOutlinePaint, stream);
3459    }
3460
3461    /**
3462     * Provides serialization support.
3463     *
3464     * @param stream  the input stream.
3465     *
3466     * @throws IOException  if there is an I/O error.
3467     * @throws ClassNotFoundException  if there is a classpath problem.
3468     */
3469    private void readObject(ObjectInputStream stream)
3470        throws IOException, ClassNotFoundException {
3471        stream.defaultReadObject();
3472        this.zoomFillPaint = SerialUtils.readPaint(stream);
3473        this.zoomOutlinePaint = SerialUtils.readPaint(stream);
3474
3475        // we create a new but empty chartMouseListeners list
3476        this.chartMouseListeners = new EventListenerList();
3477
3478        // register as a listener with sub-components...
3479        if (this.chart != null) {
3480            this.chart.addChangeListener(this);
3481        }
3482
3483    }
